description: When a decision's option rationale conflates multiple concerns (e.g., 'create initiative X AND relocate items Y into it'), the operator may agree with one concern and disagree with another. Today the only path is to accept the option and bury the modification in --notes prose, which is easy to miss downstream and has no structured consumer. Add a `modifications` field to decision-accept that captures scoped exceptions as structured data — e.g., `{"excluded_steps": [...], "additions": [...], "rationale": "..."}` — distinct from --notes. Downstream consumers (workshop agents, implementation plans generated from the decision) read modifications, not --notes prose. CLI: `--modifications='{...}'` flag or repeated `--modification=key=value`. UI: option selection with optional per-clause modifications visible in decision history. Surfaced 2026-04-24 vision walk when operator accepted dec-1776982737575948642 option A but rejected the 'relocate items' portion of the rationale; the modification had to be captured in prose in both --notes and the orchestration-summary upload, with no structured handoff.
name: prompt-manager-decision-partial-accept-with-modifications
title: Support partial-accept with structured modifications on decisions
